observations: body L1-L8: «Alpetragius», «al–Biṭrūǵī», «Hermes» and «Caldei» are letter-spaced; «al–Biṭrūǵī» has a long dash (5.4 pt), and the signs of equality of L3 and L6 measure 9.6 and 9.5 pt. The Greek ἀποτελεσματικοί (L3) has a smooth breathing on its α. The e beginning L2 prints broken, like (:, and the o of «motum» (L8) prints broken. «comperiere» (L7) is printed so.
body L9-L17: «Taun» (L10) and «Albategnus» (L16) are letter-spaced; the sign of equality of L10 measures 9.7 pt.

body L18-L24: «Ibn al–Qifṭī», «Ḥabash» and «Barhebraeus» are letter-spaced; «al–Qifṭī» has a long dash (5.5 pt). By the tabular calendar counted from 15 July 622, the year 646 of the Hiǵrah began on 25 April 1248 (Julian), as printed. The dots after «est» (L20) are six. The first d of «additione» (L23) prints broken.

body L25-L27: «Albatenii», «Letronne» and «Martin» are letter-spaced; «al–Battānī» (L26) is not, its long dash measuring 5.2 pt. The dash after «II.» prints broken, its left end apart like a point; it spans 8.0 pt. Th. H. Martin is Thomas-Henri Martin; the «Th. M. Martin» of p. 292, L12, is the same scholar.
notes_left L1-L6: «Alpetragii» and «Suter» are letter-spaced; «[sic]» stands twice, as printed. «11,v.-12,r.» has a hyphen (2.8 pt), and the dash before «Fuit» measures 8.4 pt.

notes_left L9-L16: «Ḥabash» is letter-spaced; «al-Qifṭī» and «al-Fihrist» have hyphens (3.1 pt each), «1871–72» a long dash (4.3 pt), and the dash before «Ḥabash» measures 7.2 pt. «Kitâb» has a circumflex, as printed. A point between «trepidationem» and «non-» (L12) is a speck.

notes_left L17-L20: «Gregorii Abulpharagii», «Bar––Hebraei», divided between L17 and L18, and «Bar Hebraei» (L20) are letter-spaced; «Bar–» and «–Hebraei» have long dashes (4.3 and 4.9 pt), and the sign of equality (8.0 pt) follows «vers.» without a space. The closing parenthesis of «(4)» prints broken.
notes_right L1-L3: «Barhebraei» is letter-spaced; the dash before «Cfr.» measures 6.8 pt, and «103-104» has a hyphen (3.1 pt); the second 4 of «104» prints broken.
notes_right L4-L8: «Barhebraeus» and «Lippert» are letter-spaced; «griechisch-arabischen» has a hyphen (2.5 pt).

notes_right L9-L20: «a-t-elle» has hyphens (2.5 and 2.8 pt), and the dash before «Martin» (L18) measures 8.2 pt. The L of «La» (L13) prints without its foot, like I, and the 4 of «1864» (L12) prints broken.
